$schema: The complete Relay kitchen-sink API schema.
DateTime: An ISO-8601 timestamp returned by the API.
@displayLabel: Optional presentation metadata for a field.
UserRole: The permission level assigned to a user.
UserRole.ADMIN: Can manage all content and settings.
PostStatus: The publication lifecycle of a post.
PostStatus.PUBLISHED: Visible to readers in the public feed.
SearchResult: A search hit, which may be a user or a post.
PostFilter: Optional predicates used when searching posts.
PostFilter.text: Matches words in the title or body.
User:
A person who can author and edit content.
Supports Unicode: café, 東京, and “smart quotes”; quoted text: "viewer".
User.name: The display name shown in feeds.
Query: The root of the kitchen-sink API.
Query.node: Loads any object by its globally unique identifier.
Query.node(id:): The globally unique identifier to load.
User.clientLabel: A field added by a client schema extension.
ClientDashboard: A strong client model. Relay uses the returned ID to memoize the model.
ProfileCard: A weak client model has no global ID and is returned as a complete object.
User.displayName:
A derived resolver reads a root fragment and is reevaluated when its data
changes.
